say:3:1623345002:1.female: Glad to meet a fellow educator.

say:4:1623345003:1.text: Alright, I should probably introduce myself. I'm Andre. I used to teach divination here at the Lyceum, and I helped put together some of the course materials.

say:5:1623345004:1.text: I'm ashamed to say it, but the research I left behind doesn't stand up anymore. In my time we were working with limited knowledge, and looking at it now, it's full of gaps.

say:6:1623348005:1.text: To know someone actually read my work that carefully and treated it with such respect... wow.
say:6:1623348005:1.source_cn: 知道自己的拙作被后人如此珍而重之地对待……这感觉，真好。

say:7:1623348006:1.text: Honestly, that kind of respect is worth more than any perfectly written textbook.

say:8:1623348007:1.text: Thank you. You didn't just bring me a manuscript. You brought me a little bit of peace.
